definitions.explanation: Literally 'ten thousand thunderclaps.' Used almost exclusively in the set phrase 万雷の拍手 (thunderous applause) to describe extremely loud, enthusiastic clapping from an audience.

examples.japanese: {万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ}が{起|お}きた。
{演奏|えんそう}が{終|お}わると{万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ}が{送|おく}られた。
examples.english: When the performance ended, thunderous applause was given.

examples.japanese: {優勝|ゆうしょう}が{決|き}まった{瞬間|しゅんかん}、スタジアムは{万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ}と{歓声|かんせい}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: The moment the championship was decided, the stadium was engulfed in thunderous applause and cheers.

notes:
{万雷|ばんらい} is almost always used in the fixed phrase {万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ} (thunderous applause). It is rarely used independently. The word evokes the image of ten thousand thunderbolts striking at once.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ} — thunderous applause
- {万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ}が{起|お}きる — thunderous applause breaks out
- {万雷|ばんらい}の{拍手|はくしゅ}を{浴|あ}びる — to receive thunderous applause

RELATED WORDS:
- {拍手|はくしゅ} — applause, clapping
- {喝采|かっさい} — cheers, acclaim
- {歓声|かんせい} — cheers, shouts of joy
